name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
research: 12 Nov 2026 fix: the old start/end differed by 45 deg of foot pitch on paper, but the rig's toes do not bend, so the real contact is the toe tip, not the ball: the start foot read as flat and the end toes sank 2 cm into the block. Rigid-foot model (toe tip (0,-0.196,-0.074) from the ankle, ball (0,-0.12,-0.074), heel (0,0.05,-0.07), fitted to cloud floor readings). Seated body from dumbbell_shoulder_press (bench 85, root (0,-0.035,0.494) rot -6): hip L (0.11,-0.085,0.502). Block 0.26 x 0.16 x 0.08 centred (0.12,-0.816): top z 0.08, y -0.896..-0.736. START heel low: foot rot X -15, the sole pivots over the block's back edge (ball on the corner y -0.736): ankle (0.12,-0.601,0.122), toe tip z 0.102, heel z 0.042 (4 cm off the floor, below the block top); knee (0.117,-0.538,0.567), 90 deg. END heel high: foot rot +25, toe tip on the block (z 0.081), ball over the edge: ankle (0.12,-0.659,0.231), heel z 0.189 -> heel rises 15 cm; knee (0.116,-0.516,0.657), 91 deg (knee rises 9 cm, as the thigh lifts off the seat at the knee end). Dumbbell across the lower left thigh, handle 0.10 back from the knee and 0.095 above the thigh line (thigh 0.06 + fist 0.035): start (0.12,-0.425,0.647), end (0.12,-0.389,0.712); plates hang either side of the thigh. Left arm plane 40: start elev 20.6, elbow 70, forearm (-0.514,-0.826,-0.231); end elev 50.8, elbow 89, forearm (-0.787,-0.536,-0.306) (start lands within 5 mm). Right foot flat, right hand on the right thigh (unchanged). Camera yaw 88 = true side view. Only the left calf lit (highlight_side L). S1 Kovacs 2024 (knee 90, -15..+30 deg ankle), S2 StrengthLog.
